summary: The Backrooms is a shared multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, Levels 1–6, Base Gamma and a debug room. Authored cells and place simulations assemble its spaces; shared player, combat, NPC, loot and UI systems support scavenging, fighting, dialogue and progression saved per player.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, containers, breakable furniture, shifting walls and hunters.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, loot, hounds and skin-stealers.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, supplies, NPCs, sludge and steam hazards.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze/crawl halls, hazards, creatures, Gamma checkpoint, generators and lifts.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards, residents and Database terminal.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office; offices, fountains, break-room vending, lift/stairs and Base Omega; sim lays residents and office systems.
places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel; Main Hall, guest rooms, Beverly Room and Boiler Room; residents, rentals, elevators, mahjong and Level 6 entrance.

places/level6 (3D) - Lights Out; places/level6/sim.js lays the seeded dark concrete halls, survivor-note set pieces, loot props and triggers, then shifts a wall when unwatched; whispers and mimic voices haunt the halls.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, player actions, player template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered player behavior chain; locomotion precedes movement and gameplay handlers run before critter and view3.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented view and eye position, including seated/talk views and collision-limited third person.
places/<place>/sim.js + config.yaml/cells - place setup and authored placements; Level 4/5 lay place systems, Level 6 builds its one-time hall plan and ticks local events.
scripts/ui.js and *-ui.js renderers - HUD and overlays for transitions, loot, talk, build, stats, craft, OS, horde, lockpick, mahjong and elevator floors.
scripts/view3.js - middle-mouse toggle writes player.state.tp; scripts/camera.js consumes it for the over-shoulder camera.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - K opens the HALOGEN attribute/skill sheet; stats.js owns its state and spending.
scripts/lib/body3.js - third-person body pose/swing helper called by scripts/player.js and scripts/critter.js; first-person arms remain in lib/vmpose.js.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level1.js/level2.js with data - per-level grids/layouts reused by sims, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + Level 3 data + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim, creatures and visits.
scripts/lib/level4.js, level5.js and level6.js - office/hotel plans and sanity data plus Level 6 seeded hall grid shared by geometry, simulation and player place behavior.
scripts/lib/l5-hall-layout.js + l5-hall-kit.js and l5-boiler-plan.js - hotel furnishing/door plan and boiler coordinates shared by geometry and active lay/heat scripts.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml; scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - place NPC definitions, rounds, speech, spawning and simulation helpers.
scripts/lib/npc-life.js, voices.js, hear.js - shared NPC traits/voices and spatially filtered speech/audio used by dialogue, barks and residents.
scripts/lib/hunt.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - Level 0 hunters share hearing, pack-alert, light visibility and last-sighting/lead calculations.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4/5 also export lay; places/gamma/sim.js exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level2.js - grid/layout queries and sludge sites; scripts/lib/level4.js, level5.js, level6.js - plan constants and queries.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js - PEOPLE5, roundsOf, speak, spawnResident, tickPeople; scripts/l5-elevator.js - destIndex, ears, update.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - clothing/look/roll helpers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - critter model/look/morph/baseBones; scripts/lib/seat.js - seat claims/sit/stand.
scripts/lib/npc-life.js - lifeOf and fear/want data; scripts/lib/voices.js - throatOf, vo; scripts/lib/npc-talk.js - dialogue config, prompts, parsing and checks.
scripts/lib/mahjong.js - tile/rule, fan scoring, shanten and call helpers; scripts/lib/hunt.js - hearing/alert/sighting helpers; scripts/meg-agent.js - nerveOf, onSpawn, bark, update, vanish.
scripts/lib/body3.js - swing3, fire3, stance; scripts/l6-props-geo.js - geometry; scripts/l6-spot.js - onTriggerEnter; places/level6/sim.js - cadence, tick.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/weapon condition, hunger/thirst, cents, visits, kills/deaths and combat; owns nvg/battery and publishes loud actions.
scripts/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - craftOpen/craftBench, payout redemption and hunger/thirst drain; recipes validate skill/materials.
scripts/horde.js - player horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing and spawned creatures carry owner horde id.
scripts/build.js + player.js - player scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - focus/loot/interaction and player sit state; scripts/lockpick.js owns pick state, pins and boiler-pick timestamp; seats own occupancy.
scripts/talk.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - dialogue/social memory and NPC follow; meg-agent owns routines, nerve, arm loadout, combat, fear/want, cover and corpse inspections.

scripts/mahjong.js + Level 5 table state own game lifecycle, player stake/winnings and guests; Level 6 sim owns place.state.builtV/shiftAt, while each l6-spot trigger session tracks per-player cooldowns.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered handlers: locomotion before movement; interact, grab, rest, mahjong, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, OS, lockpick and horde before critter and view3.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; view3.js writes player.state.tp → shoulder camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt while third person → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; lifts/stairs connect Levels 3–5; Level 5 east threshold → Level 6, whose stairwell returns to Level 5.
scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; Level 5/6 use state.to; place sims add inbound markers and player.js selects safe spawn/checkpoints after death.
scripts/player.js writes state.xfer → scripts/ui.js transition card; player.js gain() writes xpPop → UI aggregates XP; lvlPrompt prompts K and stats.js clears it when opening the sheet.

interact.js E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js submits choices/text/trade → talk.js/NPC ears; parsed join intent writes NPC state.follow; npc-talk.js builds lore/memory prompts and replies update rapport.
NPC state.follow → meg-agent.js pursuit/return and companion recovery; NPC threat response uses visible danger, while armed agents fight instead of fleeing; agents can inspect eligible corpses.
player.js ranged attack → lib/ballistics.js traces from eye and returns target/world impact; player.js applies damage and show() emits tracer/impact FX; weapons.yml supplies projectile parameters.
scripts/lib/loot.js place pools/item rolls → interact.js containers and player.js kill drops; Level 3 has special rolls and NVG loot is in the Level 5 table.
scripts/player.js writes state.loud on swings/shots → scripts/lib/hunt.js uses combat and movement noise to locate prey.
Level 6 sim lays labeled props and l6-spot.js triggers → player notice/sanity/audio with per-player cooldown; sim emits spatial whisper or mimic voice and moves l6-shift only when no player is near.
NPC speak functions → scripts/lib/hear.js spatially filters audio and scripts/ui.js subtitles to nearby same-place players; talk.js returns a fallback line when a reply is lost for 10 seconds.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state; Level 5 x0z0.scene hosts the hotel/Level 6 entrance and drop box.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office structure, non-colliding detail, varied props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + l4-office-geo.js - repeated cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambience, tasks and rewards.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC rounds and talk vary by faction, role, voice, look/build and routine; meg-agent.js adds nerve, loadout and combat.
smilers.js and lurkers.js use lib/hunt.js hearing/lost-trail prediction but keep distinct light/gaze and attack behavior; hounds, stealers and deathmoths have distinct pursuit behavior.
scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/lib/data/meg.yml - shared NPC combat/follow controller varies by faction, arm, nerve and target; agents fight hall creatures, inspect eligible corpses and seek cover.

scripts/mahjong.js + mahjong.yml + mahjong-looks.yml - game lifecycle/rules vary among six guests by persona, suit preference, look, dialogue, calls and sloppiness; l5-ball.js handles table guests and cleanup.

places/level6/sim.js + scripts/l6-props-geo.js/l6-spot.js - plan endpoint notes become abandoned packs, clothing, stains, sounds, sanity/voice triggers and an intermittently absent wall; props vary by endpoint narrative.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m; Level 1 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 64×64 m with 8 m offices; Level 5 96×60 m; Level 6 27×41 cells at 1.8 m and 2.4 m high.

Level 6 has no working flashlight: player.js suppresses the toggle and destroys any carried torch on arrival. Owned nvg enables F to spawn a local camera-attached green light using shared battery at 1.5× torch drain.

Level 6 builtV is versioned: v2 lays set pieces after the original plan; moving trigger/prop sites requires keeping endpoint coordinates aligned to scripts/lib/level6.js plan(). The shift wall toggles only outside a 7 m player radius.

NPC corpse inspection sets state.inspectUntil so creature controllers defer cleanup; inspectable hostile bodies persist during the look, while rats are skipped. meg-agent target acquisition uses recent line-of-sight.

Level 0 weapons no longer replenish as loose pickups; find them in containers. Lobby Wafers use token lobby_wafer; NVGs are rolled by the Level 5 loot table only, and the owned nvg token enables the Level 6 light.

Weapon kinds/variants are centralized in weapons.yml/lib/weapons.js; keep requirements, projectile/reload timing, handling stats and first-person weapon mesh offsets in sync when changing weapon definitions.
